top_signals.title: From Vulnerability Noise to Resilience: Rethinking Security in the AI Era
top_signals.summary: AI-driven development is adding complexity to software supply chains, leaving security teams overwhelmed by vulnerabilities that may pose little actual risk. RapidFort explains how runtime visibility, container hardening, and automated remediation can reduce vulnerability noise and improve software resilience. [...]
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Venezuela Unveils $237 Billion Debt Load Ahead of Restructuring
top_signals.summary: Venezuela’s government said public debt stood at $237.5 billion in 2025, setting the stage for what could be one of the largest sovereign debt restructurings in history.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
